manifest.description: Azure CLI integration for DeepSeek Harness: manage Azure resources, query ARM, deploy and diagnose through native tools.
manifest.name: dsh-az

bundle.text:
# dsh-az bundle patch layer.
#   pnpm dsh web --patch ./dsh-az/cordis.patch.yml

- insert:
    - id: az
      name: './src/index.js'

readme.text:
**Azure CLI 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件** —— 让 dsh 智能体管理 Azure 资源：查询、展示、部署、诊断。

> 独立社区项目，非官方。基于 [Azure/azure-cli](https://github.com/Azure/azure-cli)（MIT）。

- 7 个原生工具：`az_status` / `az_subscriptions` / `az_resource_query` / `az_show` / `az_activity_log` / `az_group_create` / `az_deploy`
- 所有查询 `--output json`，模型直接读结构化数据
- 支持 Bicep 与 ARM JSON 模板部署
- 写操作（group create / deploy）显式确认
- 延续微软系主题（与 SkillOpt / winget / wsl 同系列）

**Azure CLI integration for DeepSeek Harness** — manage Azure resources
through the dsh agent: query, show, deploy and diagnose.

> Independent community project, not official. Based on
> [Azure/azure-cli](https://github.com/Azure/azure-cli) (MIT).

- 7 native tools: `az_status` / `az_subscriptions` / `az_resource_query` / `az_show` / `az_activity_log` / `az_group_create` / `az_deploy`
- All queries use `--output json` for structured results
- Bicep and ARM JSON template deployment
- Writes (group create / deploy) require confirmation
